basic_info.description: Nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac, this elegant two-unit Edwardian home built in 1912 seamlessly blends historic charm with modern convenience. Set on a massive 50 x 114 lot, the property offers breathtaking city views and a rare sense of space in an idyllic setting just steps to Dolores Park.  The main residence boasts four spacious bedrooms, each filled with natural light and period details, including tall ceilings, original moldings and wood trim, and hardwood floors. A gracious living room with wood burning fireplace is flooded in light and ideal for entertaining. The kitchen preserves its vintage character while offering modern appliances and ample storage with immediate access to a rear deck and spacious/flat rear garden. Upstairs, the four bedrooms provide a retreat-like feel, with serene outlooks and classic charm throughout. Additional space in the attic is accessed by pull down stairway and awaits its next chapter/integration by the new owner.  The lower-level one-bedroom residence, with its own private entrance, is well suited for guests, extended family, or rental income. It features a comfortable living area and a charming bedroom retreat with one bathroom.  Outside, the expansive lot provides endless possibilities, from lush gardens to outdoor entertaining space.
